description: Start a temporary, email-free Pulse trial for one URL analysis. Read trial_policy and trial_allowance for the actual duration cap and remaining attempts; an existing trial key may have a lower cap. One completed/partial analysis consumes the allowance regardless of remaining tokens. A failed analysis may retry only when attempts remain. No Stripe Checkout session is created. Store the returned private API key in the client or a trusted local environment; never repost it in logs, screenshots, shared chats or issues. Confirm rights, permission, lawful access, or another legal basis before analysis. The original CC0 demo is https://pulse.studiosphere.space/assets/pulse-demo.mp3 (180 seconds); use it only if it fits the returned cap.
name: start_trial

account_type.description: The account type created by this tool.

api_key.description: Temporary Pulse API key for the trial account. Treat as private; do not print it in public logs, screenshots, GitHub issues, shared chats, or directory examples.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp when the temporary key expires.

retryable.description: Whether the caller may retry after changing state or waiting.

upgrade_path.description: Path for converting to an account.

usage_note.description: Limits and usage guidance for the trial.
